Mini Java Compiler - Phase 01 test programs.
Each test starts with a marker line "### TEST NN: label" and runs until the next marker.
The expected output of test NN is in tests/expected/test_NN.out.
Line numbers inside each test start again at 1.

### TEST 01: valid class with main method
class Test {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int x = 10; // counter
    }
}

### TEST 02: sample program from the spec
class Student {
    public static void main() {
        int age = 20;
        float grade = 85.5;
        String name = "Ali";

        if (grade >= 50) {
            grade = grade + 5;
        }
    }
}

### TEST 03: every type keyword, arrays and literals
class Types {
    int count = 0;
    float ratio = 3.14;
    boolean ready;
    char initial = 'K';
    String greeting = "Hello, Mini Java: welcome!";
    int[] marks = new int[5];
    String empty = "";
}

### TEST 04: control flow if else while for return
class ControlFlow {
    void evaluate(int limit) {
        int i = 0;
        while (i < limit) {
            if (i == 5) {
                return;
            } else {
                i = i + 1;
            }
        }
        for (i = 0; i <= 10; i = i + 1) {
            limit = limit * 2;
        }
        return limit;
    }
}
